name: Battle Pass System
description: XP progression with rewards and a client addon (/bp, /battlepass).

patches.replace: -- require removed: CSMH_SMH.ext is auto-loaded by ALE before .lua scripts; requiring it double-loads CSMH and crashes the server

sql.note: tables must exist BEFORE the server starts

sql.statement: UPDATE battlepass_config SET config_value='{enabled}' WHERE config_key='enabled'; UPDATE battlepass_config SET config_value='{max_level}' WHERE config_key='max_level'; UPDATE battlepass_config SET config_value='{exp_per_level}' WHERE config_key='exp_per_level'; UPDATE battlepass_config SET config_value='{exp_scaling}' WHERE config_key='exp_scaling'; UPDATE battlepass_config SET config_value='90100' WHERE config_key='npc_entry'; UPDATE battlepass_config SET config_value='{debug_mode}' WHERE config_key='debug_mode';

DELETE FROM creature_template WHERE entry=90100; INSERT INTO creature_template (entry, name, subname, minlevel, maxlevel, faction, npcflag, unit_class, unit_flags, type, AIName, ScriptName) VALUES (90100, 'Battle Pass Vendor', 'Battle Pass', 80, 80, 35, 1, 1, 512, 7, '', ''); DELETE FROM creature_template_model WHERE CreatureID=90100; INSERT INTO creature_template_model (CreatureID, Idx, CreatureDisplayID, DisplayScale, Probability, VerifiedBuild) VALUES (90100, 0, 25478, 1, 1, 0);
sql.note: NPC 90100 is NOT in upstream SQL (the scripts read its entry from battlepass_config.npc_entry, upstream default 90100). The model row is what lets AzerothCore load it: without one Creature::InitEntry refuses the entry and .npc add 90100 fails. Display 25478 is the one wow-manage.sh used. Worldserver restart required before .npc add: creature_template is not hot-loaded.

sql.statement: DELETE FROM creature WHERE id=90100; DELETE FROM creature_template_model WHERE CreatureID=90100; DELETE FROM creature_template WHERE entry=90100;
sql.note: the vendor Yu'lon created goes with the module, spawns included: a spawn of an entry that is gone is an error at every world start

npcs.name: Battle Pass Vendor
npcs.note: Spawn manually after a restart: .npc add 90100

prompts.question: Turn the battle pass on? (1 = on, 0 = off)
